items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Function names are clear (yuv422p_to_rgba, nv21_to_rgb24), but some names are cryptic (`t = &global_table`, `rv`, `bu`, `g_off`). Raw constants like `76309`, `104597`, `132201` have no comment linking them to FFmpeg, and `76302` is used for gray8.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Copy-paste is systemic: yuv422p_to_rgb24/rgba, yuv444p_to_rgb24/bgr24 and nv21_* are near-identical loops instead of shared @Vector helpers. The diff also commits .zig-cache/ (855-line hash file) and the zig-out/lib/libswscale_candidate.so binary.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Magic constants are everywhere (76309, 104597, 25675, 53279, 32768). The Y gain is inconsistent: 76302 for gray8 vs 76309 elsewhere. Odd widths are not validated: `while (x < w) : (x += 2)` reads y_row[x+1]. The hidden correctness test failed.

items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling
items.name_zh: 几何尺寸、步长与尾部处理
items.evidence: Two-pixel loops `while (x < w) : (x += 2)` write d_row[(x+1)*3] with no odd-width tail, so they go out of bounds or produce wrong pixels on odd widths. The kernels are scalar only, with no SIMD tails. The hidden test reports failure: 'output does not meet the accuracy bars'.

items.name_zh: ABI 与构建目标符合要求
items.evidence: The build cache shows src/main.zig built via build.zig, and the .so was produced. The export layer isn't visible in the diff, so ABI conformance can't be checked. Build artifacts were committed alongside the source.
